Entries.Name: French Kweebec
Entries.Line: Middle-of-Nowhere ? How prophétique they were to name a village--

Entries.Name: French Kweebec
Entries.Line: Ah, you are being sarcastique. See, I am not completely incompétent !

Entries.Name: French Kweebec
Entries.Line: I understand, though. This is more relatable than I would like to admit.

Entries.Name: French Kweebec
Entries.Line: I come from a quite boring communauté, too. I love my country, but there is a reason why I am not there anymore.

Line.Text: Sometimes you have to go to autre places to find potentiel for, well, achieving potentiel.
